card: Configures Guix to build official Linux x86_64 and aarch64 release binaries (excluding bitcoin-qt) as static position-independent executables (-static-pie) using glibc 2.44. This eliminates dynamic linker dependencies, allowing bitcoind and utilities to run on musl-based distributions such as Alpine Linux and on older Linux distributions, while facilitating aarch64 pointer authentication (#19075). Statically compiling glibc and patching out dlopen means dynamic NSS modules (such as mDNS, LDAP, or SSSD) will no longer function for name resolution. Post-build symbol and security check scripts are updated to assert properties of static ELF executables.
changed_since_previous: Rebased onto the CMake build system migration, passing -static-pie flags via CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS instead of autotools LDFLAGS, and added release notes.
evidence: PR description: 'Release binaries for x86_64 and aarch64 Linux (except for bitcoin-qt) are now compiled with -static-pie, making them more portable. They can now be run on non-glibc based systems, as well as on systems that ship with older glibcs than those previously supported.'
Linked issue #19075: 'build: Investigate aarch64 pointer authentication'
problem: Linux release binaries dynamically link against glibc and the host dynamic linker, preventing them from running on non-glibc distributions like Alpine Linux and on systems with glibc versions older than the build toolchain. Dynamic linking also impedes security hardening mitigations such as aarch64 pointer authentication (#19075).

risk.why: Defects in glibc patching, static linking flags, or toolchain configuration could produce malfunctioning, incompatible, or insecure official Linux release binaries.

scope_notes: Touches Guix toolchains and manifests, adding custom glibc patches for reproducible builds and static NSS handling. Applies to bitcoind and utility binaries; bitcoin-qt remains dynamically linked.
summary: Configure Guix to build official Linux x86_64 and aarch64 non-GUI executables (bitcoind and CLI tools) as static position-independent executables (`-static-pie`) using glibc 2.44. Apply patches to glibc to eliminate non-deterministic Guix store paths and disable runtime dlopening of dynamic NSS modules. Update Guix post-build symbol-check and security-check scripts to verify static ELF binaries.
